text: is it possible to, and idk, maybe not maybe so but effectively pack everything into one archive that then can just be unpacked over there and that way if for whatever reason i need to do it over usb its just a packed zip
resolution: Implemented a single portable tar.gz archive workflow in tools/editor-transfer. The pack command can write directly to the Mac SMB share, the default sibling path, or any USB path; unpack validates the archive, mirrors its managed contents, preserves machine-local Git/dependencies/platform tooling, and keeps timestamped backups of replaced or deleted files. A real 129 MB pack and 351 MB restore round trip passed, including SMB-alias, deletion, rollback, and executable-mode checks.
